svg.title: Weekly commits to each protocol: official and third-party repositories
svg.desc: Small multiples, one panel per protocol, shared scale, official and third-party lines. MCP 4442 official and 3177 third-party commits; A2A 2300 official and 151 third-party commits; x402 1046 official and 955 third-party commits; MPP 1106 official and 396 third-party commits; Web Bot Auth 93 official and 1062 third-party commits; UCP 703 official and 310 third-party commits; L402 272 official and 197 third-party commits; KYA-OS 324 official commits; ACP 100 official and 146 third-party commits; PAP 3 official and 176 third-party commits; AP2 20 official and 124 third-party commits; KYAPay 62 official and 77 third-party commits; ANS 104 official and 14 third-party commits; TAP 1 official and 112 third-party commits; x401 47 official and 4 third-party commits; Baselayer KYA has no data (closed product)
svg.text: Weekly commits to each protocol: official and third-party repositories
Last 52 weeks to mid-Oct 2026. Same scale in every panel (0 to 360), sorted by total commits.
Each line adds commits across its repositories, which are listed below. Dashed shading means no repository existed yet.

Official repositories added together in each panel
A2A: A2A, a2a-python, a2a-js, a2a-java, a2a-go, a2a-dotnet, a2a-rs, a2a-samples, a2a-inspector
MCP: modelcontextprotocol, typescript-sdk, python-sdk, java-sdk, go-sdk, csharp-sdk, rust-sdk
UCP: ucp, python-sdk, js-sdk, samples, conformance, ucp-schema
Third-party repositories added together (hand-picked examples; ‡ = counted under more than one protocol)
Web Bot Auth: vestauth, samesame, regent-httpsig
Up to three per protocol that implement the protocol itself (SDK, server, library, plugin), highest stars first,
after setting aside applications that merely use it and curated lists. This is a sample, not a census.
GitHub repositories tagged with each protocol topic, applications included: MCP 37,653, x402 3,827, A2A 604, L402 110, UCP 66, Web Bot Auth 41, ACP 27, AP2 19.
